name: B4·3 Bridal Pipeline — long-nurture drip + wedding countdown + trousseau checklist (3 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step
1. Tab **Bridal**: Name, Phone, WeddingDate (YYYY-MM-DD), Stage, Budget, LastTouch, Notes. Move any 'Wedding/Engagement' enquiry from the CRM here.
2. Variables: GEMINI_API_KEY, TG_OWNER_CHAT_ID, BRAND_NAME. Attach Telegram + Sheets credentials; replace REPLACE_SHEET_ID.

## WHY THIS EXISTS
Bridal = the biggest tickets, decided over 3-6 months. Whoever stays warmly present without pestering wins the trousseau. This runs the whole courtship automatically.

## HOW IT RUNS (daily 09:00)
For each bride, days-to-wedding decides the touch:
• **T-180/150/120** (monthly): inspiration touch — AI writes a personalised style/lookbook message.
• **T-90:** trousseau checklist message (necklace set, bangles, earrings, maang tikka, waist belt, groom's chain…) + invite for a private preview.
• **T-60:** booking push — reserve pieces / customisation deadline reminder (karigar lead time!).
• **T-30:** final-fitting + gold-rate-lock offer.
• **T-7:** warm 'we are with you' + emergency-service note.
• **T+15 (after):** congratulations + review/photo request + anniversary capture.
Each touch = one-tap wa.me link on your Telegram; LastTouch prevents duplicates.

## 🔧 FIX
• Nothing fires → WeddingDate format must be YYYY-MM-DD.
• Too frequent → edit the DAYS map in 'Compute touches'.

parameters.jsonBody: ={ "contents": [{ "parts": [{ "text": "Write ONE warm WhatsApp message (2-4 lines, no pressure, Indian family-jeweller tone, address as '{{$json.Name}} ji') for {{$env.BRAND_NAME}}. Bride: wedding in {{$json.days}} days, budget {{$json.Budget||'unknown'}}, notes: {{$json.Notes||'none'}}. Touch type: {{$json.touch}} — inspire=style inspiration & invite to browse; trousseau=share the classic South-Indian bridal checklist & offer a private preview; booking=gently remind customisation/karigar lead-times & reserving pieces; ratelock=final fittings + today's-rate booking benefit; support=warm 'we are ready for your big week' note; after=congratulations + request a photo/review + note their anniversary. Return only the message text." }] }] }
